English: A concave lens forms an upright, diminished virtual image of a real object, including when the object moves farther away.

English: The objective lenses of both a microscope and telescope form an inverted first real image, their shared characteristic.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Kelantan2024_Q37

English: Aim the lens at a distant object, adjust the screen until the image is sharp, then measure lens-to-screen distance as the approximate focal length.

question: KelantanYik2024_Q37

English: A magnifying glass places the object inside the focal length of a convex lens to form an upright, enlarged virtual image.

title: F5 Chp 7
question: Melaka2024_Q37

中文：物距小于焦距时，凸透镜形成正立、放大的虚像，适合检查手表细小零件。
English: With the object inside the focal length, a convex lens forms an upright enlarged virtual image suitable for inspecting small watch parts.
